ASCII Markdown characters are escaped when escapeAscii is true

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"escape_ascii\":true}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<p>Text with # hash and [brackets] and * star</p>", options: _options)
print(result)
```
